inline_attachment_bytes.description: Capture decoded attachment bytes inline. Otherwise exact identities and source locators are retained without duplicating source bytes.

max_decoded_part_bytes.description: Maximum decoded bytes retained or recursively parsed for one MIME entity.

max_header_bytes.description: Maximum RFC 5322 header block accepted as structured headers.

max_mime_depth.description: Maximum MIME entity depth, with the root entity at depth zero.

max_mime_parts.description: Maximum number of MIME entities emitted for one message.

parse_nested_attachments.description: Dispatch locally supplied attachment bytes to enabled Grist parsers.
